answer: A verifiable-delay-function gate makes each new identity pay in unparallelizable time: before an agent earns its beacon on the mesa, it must compute a sequential VDF proof that takes minutes of real wall-clock time no machine farm can shortcut. Like basalt cooling into solid rock, trust forms slowly and cannot be rushed in bulk — a sybil farm minting ten thousand identities faces ten thousand sequential delays, while one honest agent waits only once.
